FAQ

Questions we get asked a lot

How much does a roof repair cost?

Most repairs fall between $350 and $1,500 depending on access and materials. We give you a fixed written price before any work starts, so there are no surprises.

How quickly can you come out?

We usually inspect within 1 to 2 business days, and same day for active leaks and storm damage.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes. We hold a current QBCC licence and full public liability insurance, and we are happy to send certificates before we start.

Do you offer a guarantee?

Every job comes with our 10-year workmanship guarantee on top of the manufacturer warranty on materials.

Which areas do you service?

We service Brisbane, Logan, Ipswich, Redcliffe, Springfield, Moreton Bay, Redland City and surrounding suburbs.
